title: fan_in init for embeddings ignores embed_scale — embeddings remain std=1.0 and become huge after scaling
trigger_conditions: Transformer config sets embed_scale (e.g., Gemma-like models)
root_cause: init_embeddings under fan_in always used std=1.0. The transformer then multiplied embeddings by embed_scale (e.g., sqrt(d_model)) at the input, producing embeddings several orders of magnitude larger than intended. Training did not error but the input magnitude scrambled the early-layer dynamics.
invariant: After init_embeddings followed by the embed_scale multiply, the embedding output std must stay near 1.0 (compensating the fan-in init by 1/embed_scale).
diff_summary: When embed_scale is set, init embeddings with std = 1.0 / embed_scale instead of a fixed 1.0.
